components.name: vLLM-HUST Runtime
components.summary_en: Upstream-synchronized HUST fork of official vLLM and owner of the HUST domain-contract seam; it is a runtime distribution, not a plugin.
components.summary_zh: 与官方 vLLM 上游同步的 HUST fork，也是 HUST 领域契约 seam 的所有者；它是运行时发行分支，不是插件。

components.name: vLLM-HUST Extension Manager
components.summary_en: Provider-neutral discovery, compatibility, configuration, state, plan, render, and check layer. The current source build rejects import-only descriptors and unhealthy required services; no public PyPI alpha exists yet.
components.summary_zh: Provider-neutral 的发现、兼容性、配置、状态、plan、render 与 check 层。当前源码版会拒绝启用 import-only 描述包，也会阻止依赖服务不健康的新启动；尚未发布公开 PyPI alpha。

components.name: vLLM Production Stack HUST
components.summary_en: Thin HUST fork of the upstream Kubernetes control plane, owning only the arm64 carrier and narrowly required integration fixes. Controller reconciliation, metrics-backed scaling, and real GLM Router failure/recovery are verified. Commit 7611dfa was built, smoke-tested, and published to GHCR by GitHub-hosted runners, then pulled and entrypoint-tested on arm64 host 91; amd64 is not required, and self-hosted infrastructure is not a dependency.
components.summary_zh: 官方 Kubernetes 控制面的 HUST 薄 fork，仅承载 arm64 发布载体和极少必要集成补丁；commit 7611dfa 已由 GitHub-hosted runner 构建、烟测并发布 GHCR，随后在 91 arm64 目标宿主完成拉取与入口验收，不要求 amd64 或 self-hosted 基础设施。

components.name: vLLM Ascend HUST
components.summary_en: Upstream-synchronized HUST fork of official vLLM Ascend, delivered as the Ascend platform distribution paired with vLLM-HUST; it is not a HUST plugin.
components.summary_zh: 与官方 vLLM Ascend 上游同步的 HUST fork，作为与 vLLM-HUST 配套的 Ascend 平台发行分支交付；它不是 HUST 插件。

components.name: vLLM Metal HUST
components.summary_en: HUST fork of official vLLM Metal for Apple Silicon platform integration; it is a complete platform distribution, not a plugin.
components.summary_zh: 面向 Apple Silicon 平台集成的官方 vLLM Metal HUST fork；它是完整平台发行分支，不是插件。

components.name: Triton Ascend HUST
components.summary_en: HUST fork of official Triton Ascend and the compiler/kernel runtime substrate used for Ascend validation; it is not a vLLM plugin.
components.summary_zh: 官方 Triton Ascend 的 HUST fork，也是昇腾验证所用的编译器与算子运行时底座；它不是 vLLM 插件。

components.name: SGLang HUST
components.summary_en: HUST fork of official SGLang and a sibling inference-runtime distribution; it is an independent system, not a vLLM-HUST plugin.
components.summary_zh: 官方 SGLang 的 HUST fork，也是独立的同级推理运行时发行分支；它不是 vLLM-HUST 插件。

components.name: Mooncake HUST
components.summary_en: Thin, upstream-first HUST fork of Mooncake. Upstream already supplies Ascend NPU and arm64 release paths, so the fork currently carries no core delta; verified paths include non-CUDA TCP/Store and the 0.3.11.post1 Ascend transport.
components.summary_zh: 上游优先的 Mooncake HUST 薄 fork。官方已提供 Ascend NPU 与 arm64 发布路径，因此当前不维护核心差异；已验证 non-CUDA TCP/Store 与 0.3.11.post1 Ascend transport。

components.name: Mooncake vLLM Connectors
components.summary_en: Official vLLM MooncakeStoreConnector validated on Ascend with 9-key save/load and outage/recovery evidence; the non-invasive Host Provider checks NPU transport and operation evidence while Mooncake retains service ownership.
components.summary_zh: 官方 vLLM MooncakeStoreConnector 已在 Ascend 完成 9-key save/load 与故障恢复实测；无侵入 Host Provider 检查 NPU transport 和操作证据，Mooncake 仍保留服务所有权。

compatibility.requirements_en: A separately operated Mooncake service is required.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 需要单独运行并运维 Mooncake 服务。

components.name: PegaFlow
components.summary_en: HUST-owned KV state system with storage, transfer, and metadata services.
components.summary_zh: 包含存储、传输与元数据服务的 HUST 自有 KV 状态系统。

components.name: PegaFlow vLLM Connectors
components.summary_en: Non-invasive PegaFlow Host Provider and PegaKVConnector profile. It renders vLLM KV-transfer configuration and health checks, while the external operator retains service lifecycle and stored-data ownership.
components.summary_zh: 无侵入 PegaFlow Host Provider 与 PegaKVConnector profile；只生成 vLLM KV-transfer 配置并执行健康检查，服务生命周期和已存 KV 数据仍由外部运维者负责。

compatibility.requirements_en: PegaFlow must be deployed and operated separately.
compatibility.requirements_zh: PegaFlow 必须单独部署和运维。

components.name: BidKV
integration_surfaces: official vLLM scheduler contract (not yet supported)
components.summary_en: Scheduler-local policy supported on vLLM-HUST 0.23; real Ascend KV-pressure selection and next-process rollback pass, while official vLLM remains unsupported.
components.summary_zh: scheduler 本地策略；vLLM-HUST 0.23 上的真实 Ascend KV 压力选择与下次进程回退已通过，官方 vLLM 暂不支持。
components.public_effect_en: On vLLM-HUST 0.23, core contract tests plus real Qwen3-0.6B Ascend KV-pressure victim selection, request completion, disable, and next-process rollback passed on server 91; repetition from clean release artifacts remains pending.
components.public_effect_zh: 在 vLLM-HUST 0.23 上，core contract 测试以及真实 Qwen3-0.6B 昇腾 KV 压力 victim 选择、请求完成、禁用和下一进程回退已在 91 服务器通过；仍待使用干净发行制品复测。

compatibility.requirements_en: Official vLLM is not supported; use the vLLM-HUST scheduler-policy seam.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 不支持官方 vLLM；必须使用 vLLM-HUST scheduler-policy seam。

components.name: DiffSpec
components.summary_en: Managed 0.2-experimental speculative-decoding extension for vLLM Ascend 0.23. It uses the official general-plugin discovery entry point but still patches unversioned configuration, runner, attention, sampling, and device surfaces in process.
components.summary_zh: 面向 vLLM Ascend 0.23 的 0.2-experimental 可管理推测解码扩展；使用官方 general-plugin 发现入口，但仍会在进程内修改未版本化的配置、runner、attention、sampling 与设备路径。
components.public_effect_en: On Ascend 910B2 with Llama-3.1-8B and batch size 1, the published 32K–128K long-context measurements report 1.69×–4.26× decode speedup.
components.public_effect_zh: 公开测量采用 Ascend 910B2、Llama-3.1-8B、batch size 1；32K–128K 长上下文解码加速 1.69×–4.26×。

compatibility.requirements_en: Requires a draft model configuration and still patches private in-process surfaces.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 需要 draft model 配置，且仍会修改进程内私有接入面。

components.name: LatchMoE
components.summary_en: vLLM Ascend in-process MoE offload extension for the pinned vLLM 0.21/HUST seam. Its validated launcher preserves the real first-release limits: one NPU, max-num-seqs 1, and prefix cache disabled.
components.summary_zh: 面向固定 vLLM 0.21/HUST seam 的 vLLM Ascend 进程内 MoE offload 扩展；经验证的 launcher 保留首版真实约束：单 NPU、max-num-seqs=1、关闭 prefix cache。
components.public_effect_en: A qualified Qwen3-30B-A3B run on one Ascend 910B2 with 14 GiB offload sustained 16.70 ± 0.27 tok/s and released physical HBM to 5% after service exit; this is not an A/B speedup claim.
components.public_effect_zh: Qwen3-30B-A3B 在单张 Ascend 910B2、14 GiB offload 下实测 16.70 ± 0.27 tok/s，服务退出后物理 HBM 降至 5%；该结果不是 A/B 加速声明。

compatibility.requirements_en: One NPU, max-num-seqs=1, prefix cache disabled, and the HUST MoE hook are required.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 需要单 NPU、max-num-seqs=1、关闭 prefix cache，并使用 HUST MoE hook。

components.name: Adaptive Quantized KV
components.summary_en: Installable, discoverable research descriptor with compatibility receipts. It remains import-only, and the Extension Manager refuses enablement until vLLM Ascend provides the observer and ACL Graph lifecycle contracts.
components.summary_zh: 可安装、可发现并带兼容性回执的研究描述包；当前仍为 import-only，在 vLLM Ascend 提供 observer 与 ACL Graph 生命周期合同前，Extension Manager 会拒绝启用。
components.public_effect_en: Packaging, inert discovery, and compatibility receipts pass on Python 3.10, 3.12, and 3.14. No runtime or performance result is claimed yet.
components.public_effect_zh: Python 3.10、3.12、3.14 已通过打包、惰性发现与兼容性回执验证；当前不声明运行时或性能效果。

compatibility.requirements_en: Observer and ACL Graph lifecycle contracts are not available yet.
compatibility.requirements_zh: observer 与 ACL Graph 生命周期合同尚未提供。

components.name: Ascend Quant Toolkit
components.summary_en: Offline model-artifact preparation toolkit. It is not a vLLM plugin and remains independently usable; public package publication is blocked pending an owner license declaration.
components.summary_zh: 离线模型产物制备工具，不是 vLLM 插件，可独立使用；在项目负责人声明许可证前不发布公共包。

components.name: Ascend Quant Runtime Descriptor
components.name_zh: 昇腾量化运行时描述器
components.summary_en: Import-only artifact-contract validator, separate from the offline toolkit. The Manager refuses enablement; serving activation awaits typed vLLM Ascend loader/operator contracts and an owner-approved value allowlist.
components.summary_zh: 与离线工具分离的 import-only 产物合同校验器；Manager 会拒绝启用，服务侧激活仍等待 vLLM Ascend 的 typed loader/operator 合同和负责人批准的值域白名单。
components.public_effect_en: The public extension validates versioned W4A8 artifacts and fails closed on unknown schemas, layouts, or operator configurations; runtime acceleration is not enabled yet.
components.public_effect_zh: 已公开版本化 W4A8 产物校验，遇到未知 schema、布局或算子配置会 fail-closed；尚未启用运行时加速。

compatibility.requirements_en: Typed loader/operator contracts and an approved value allowlist are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 激活前需要 typed loader/operator 合同和批准后的值域白名单。

components.name: Ascend KV Compression
components.summary_en: KV transformation and compression provider built on transactional KV lifecycle hooks.
components.summary_zh: 建立在事务化 KV 生命周期接口上的状态转换与压缩 provider。
components.public_effect_en: On one Ascend 910B2 with Qwen2.5-Coder-14B, published matched runs report +10.25% long-context throughput, +4.68% under KV pressure, and a 75% physical prompt-KV reduction; the 64-case recall check changed from 64/64 to 63/64.
components.public_effect_zh: 单张 Ascend 910B2、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B 的公开配对测试中：长上下文吞吐 +10.25%，KV 压力吞吐 +4.68%，物理 prompt KV 减少 75%；64 例 recall 从 64/64 变为 63/64。

compatibility.requirements_en: Use one plain full-attention KV group with block size 128 and separate contiguous BF16/FP16 K/V tensors; disable prefix caching, async scheduling, and the independent KNorm compressor. Multi-device, hybrid/MLA, sliding-window, speculative-decoding, KV-transfer, sparse-layout, and quantized-KV configurations fail closed.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 仅支持单一普通 full-attention KV group、block size 128，以及分离且连续的 BF16/FP16 K/V tensor；需关闭 prefix caching、async scheduling 与独立 KNorm compressor。多设备、hybrid/MLA、sliding-window、speculative decoding、KV transfer、稀疏布局和量化 KV 配置均会 fail-closed。

components.name: Prefix Router
components.summary_en: Owner-led migration of the legacy prefix-aware router into an external control-plane router plus a narrow cache-event adapter. Repository scaffold only; no installable release yet.
components.summary_zh: 由原贡献者主导，把 legacy 前缀感知路由迁移为外部控制面 Router 与窄幅 cache-event 适配器；目前仅为迁移仓库，尚无可安装发行版。

components.name: KV Tiering
components.summary_en: Owner-led migration of legacy device/CPU/filesystem KV residency and lifecycle management. Repository scaffold only; destructive shared-state operations are outside the manager boundary.
components.summary_zh: 由原贡献者主导迁移 legacy 设备、CPU 与文件系统 KV 驻留及生命周期管理；目前仅为迁移仓库，Manager 不负责破坏性共享状态操作。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: tier KV residency across device, CPU, and filesystem storage. The public repository is still a migration scaffold and publishes no benchmark claim.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：在设备、CPU 与文件系统之间分层管理 KV 驻留；当前仍是迁移脚手架，尚无公开 benchmark 声明。

platforms: Device / CPU / filesystem tiers are targets only; unverified
compatibility.requirements_en: The repository contains README, provenance, and ownership records only. A versioned host contract, package or manifest, implementation, and platform validation are all required before installation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 仓库目前仅有 README、来源和负责人记录；安装前仍需版本化宿主合同、package 或 manifest、实现代码与平台验证。

components.name: KNorm
components.summary_en: Owner-led extraction of the legacy KNorm KV-compression method behind a host-owned transactional lifecycle. Repository scaffold only; prefix-cache and mutation-owner conflicts remain release gates.
components.summary_zh: 由原贡献者主导，把 legacy KNorm 抽取为宿主事务化 KV 生命周期之后的压缩方法；目前仅为迁移仓库，prefix cache 与 KV 修改所有权冲突仍是发布门槛。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: extract KNorm as a host-governed KV compression method. The public scaffold makes no performance or quality claim yet.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：把 KNorm 抽取为由宿主管理的 KV 压缩方法；公开脚手架尚不声明性能或质量结果。

compatibility.requirements_en: The repository contains README, provenance, and ownership records only. A package or manifest, implementation, and proof of safe composition with prefix caching and other KV block-table mutation owners are required before installation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 仓库目前仅有 README、来源和负责人记录；安装前仍需 package 或 manifest、实现代码，并证明可与 prefix caching 及其他 KV block-table 修改方安全组合。

components.name: PyramidKV Ascend
components.summary_en: Owner-led recovery of the legacy PyramidKV Ascend provider with its fail-closed capability matrix and quality evidence. Repository scaffold only; the closed legacy PR is migration input, not a release.
components.summary_zh: 由原贡献者主导恢复 legacy PyramidKV Ascend provider，并保留 fail-closed 能力矩阵与质量证据；目前仅为迁移仓库，已关闭的 legacy PR 不是发行版。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: an Ascend PyramidKV provider with a fail-closed capability matrix and explicit quality evidence. The migration scaffold is not a released performance result.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：提供带 fail-closed 能力矩阵和显式质量证据的 Ascend PyramidKV provider；迁移脚手架不等于已发布性能结果。

platforms: Ascend NPU target; hardware validation pending
compatibility.requirements_en: The repository contains README, provenance, and ownership records only. A package or manifest, implementation, preserved fail-closed capability matrix, prompt-admission guard, quality evidence, graph/model restrictions, and Ascend validation are required before installation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 仓库目前仅有 README、来源和负责人记录；安装前仍需 package 或 manifest、实现代码，并保留 fail-closed 能力矩阵、prompt-admission guard、质量证据、graph/model 限制并完成昇腾验证。

components.name: SliceGPT
components.summary_en: Owner-led migration split into an offline SliceGPT conversion toolkit and a serving-time artifact loader. Repository scaffold only; the artifact schema and runtime contract are not frozen.
components.summary_zh: 由原贡献者主导，拆分为离线 SliceGPT 转换工具与服务期产物加载器；目前仅为迁移仓库，产物 schema 和运行时契约尚未冻结。

components.name: RIDE Control Plane
components.summary_en: External cross-instance decision system for admission, placement, routing, and global policy.
components.summary_zh: 负责准入、放置、路由与全局策略的外部跨实例决策系统。

components.name: vLLM Local Control Host
components.summary_en: Default-off core host that authenticates bounded same-UID Unix-socket actions and executes the fixed read-only health probe through a process boundary.
components.summary_zh: 默认关闭的核心本地宿主：认证同 UID 的有界 Unix socket action，并通过进程边界执行固定只读健康探针。

components.name: RIDE Remote Runtime Sidecar
components.summary_en: Separately built TLS 1.3 mutual-authentication sidecar that allowlists remote certificate fingerprints and transparently forwards bounded signed frames into the vLLM local control host.
components.summary_zh: 独立构建的 TLS 1.3 双向认证 sidecar：按证书指纹允许远程身份，并将有界签名帧透明转发到 vLLM 本地控制宿主。

components.name: Quantized KV Cache
components.summary_en: Owner-led carrier for INT8, KIVI INT4, and dynamic quantized KV-cache work. It is distinct from offline model quantization and Adaptive Quantized KV.
components.summary_zh: INT8、KIVI INT4 与动态量化 KV cache 的原负责人迁移载体；与离线模型量化和 Adaptive Quantized KV 分开治理。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: one owner-led home for INT8, KIVI INT4, and dynamic KV-cache quantization. Public benchmark results remain pending migration.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：统一承载 INT8、KIVI INT4 与动态 KV Cache 量化；公开 benchmark 结果仍待迁移。

compatibility.requirements_en: The wheel, fail-closed dtype/layout resolver, and manifest are installable and inspectable; vLLM Ascend attachment, device kernels, and hardware evidence are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: wheel、fail-closed dtype/layout resolver 与 manifest 可安装、可检查；激活前仍需补齐 vLLM Ascend 接入、设备 kernel 与硬件证据。

components.name: SimLLM
components.summary_en: Owner-led task-similarity KV-reuse carrier. Release remains blocked until the relationship to the unlicensed public SimLLM repository is resolved.
components.summary_zh: 任务相似度 KV 复用的原负责人迁移载体；在厘清与无许可证公开 SimLLM 仓库的关系前禁止发布。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: reuse KV state across similar tasks. Release and performance claims remain blocked until provenance and licensing are resolved.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：在相似任务之间复用 KV 状态；在来源与许可证厘清前，不发布版本或性能声明。

compatibility.requirements_en: The host-contract and license-gate wheel is installable and inspectable; provenance and licensing must be resolved before a clean runtime implementation or activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 宿主合同与 license-gate wheel 可安装、可检查；洁净运行时实现或激活前必须解决来源与许可证问题。

components.name: Unified Communication
components.summary_en: Owner-led carrier for a device-neutral communication library plus a narrow vLLM Host Provider; it is not an import-time scheduler plugin.
components.summary_zh: 设备中立通信库及窄 vLLM Host Provider 的原负责人迁移载体；不是 import-time scheduler 插件。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: a device-neutral communication backend and narrow vLLM host-provider boundary. Runtime activation and performance evidence remain owner work.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：提供设备中立通信后端与窄 vLLM Host Provider 边界；运行时激活和性能证据仍待负责人完成。

compatibility.requirements_en: The device-neutral registry and strategy wheel is installable and inspectable; backend packages, collective delegation, and hardware evidence are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 设备中立的 registry 与策略 wheel 可安装、可检查；激活前仍需后端包、collective delegation 与硬件证据。

components.name: Split-Batch / Full-Graph Parallel
components.summary_en: Owner-led carrier for split-batch planning, dual-stream replay, and full-graph parallel execution; core retains graph-lifecycle ownership.
components.summary_zh: split-batch 规划、双流 replay 与 full-graph 并行执行的原负责人迁移载体；graph 生命周期仍由 core 拥有。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: split-batch planning, dual-stream replay, and full-graph parallel execution. Public matched performance results are not available yet.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：split-batch 规划、双流 replay 与 full-graph 并行执行；尚无公开配对性能结果。

compatibility.requirements_en: The default-off dual-pad planner and prechecks are installable and inspectable; graph/worker execution contracts and Ascend validation are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 默认关闭的 dual-pad planner 与前置检查可安装、可检查；激活前仍需 graph/worker 执行合同与昇腾验证。

components.name: KV Transfer Observability
components.summary_en: Owner-led observability carrier for identity-bound KV transfer, recovery, descriptor layout, and first-compute receipts; it owns no KV data or service lifecycle.
components.summary_zh: 面向身份绑定 KV 传输、恢复、descriptor layout 与首次计算回执的可观测性迁移载体；不拥有 KV 数据或服务生命周期。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: auditable receipts for identity-bound KV transfer, recovery, descriptor layout, and first compute. It claims observability, not speedup.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：为身份绑定 KV 传输、恢复、descriptor layout 与首次计算生成可审计回执；声明的是可观测性，不是加速。

compatibility.requirements_en: Address-free event and descriptor sinks are installable and inspectable; bounded automatic vLLM attachment and runtime receipts are required before integration.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 无地址事件与 descriptor sink 可安装、可检查；集成前仍需有界的 vLLM 自动接入与运行回执。

components.name: Layered Prefill
components.summary_en: Owner-led optional layered-prefill carrier. The HUST integration must remain distinct from the MIT upstream project and disabled by default.
components.summary_zh: 可选 layered-prefill 的原负责人迁移载体；HUST 集成须与 MIT 上游项目区分，并保持默认关闭。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: optional layered prefill behind an explicit, default-off integration boundary. Public HUST-specific benchmark results are not available yet.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：以显式、默认关闭的接入边界提供 layered prefill；尚无 HUST 集成专属公开 benchmark。

compatibility.requirements_en: Stage partitioning, request metadata, model-adapter declarations, and MoE cursor logic are installable and inspectable; partial-forward attachment, opt-in proof, and Ascend evidence are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 阶段划分、请求 metadata、model-adapter 声明与 MoE cursor 逻辑可安装、可检查；激活前仍需 partial-forward 接入、opt-in 证明与昇腾证据。

components.name: Activation Sparsity
components.summary_en: Owner-led TEAL and LaRoSA research carrier. No sparse kernel, quality, model, hardware, or support claim is made from the unmerged source PR.
components.summary_zh: TEAL 与 LaRoSA 的原负责人研究载体；来源 PR 未合并，不声明 sparse kernel、质量、模型、硬件或支持范围。
components.public_effect_en: Research preview: package TEAL and LaRoSA activation-sparsity work behind an extension boundary. No kernel, quality, model, hardware, or speedup claim is public yet.
components.public_effect_zh: 研究预览：把 TEAL 与 LaRoSA 激活稀疏工作封装到扩展边界之后；尚不公开 kernel、质量、模型、硬件或加速声明。

compatibility.requirements_en: Fail-closed TEAL/LaRoSA configuration validation is installable and inspectable; kernel, quality, model, attachment, and hardware evidence are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: fail-closed TEAL/LaRoSA 配置校验可安装、可检查；激活前仍需 kernel、质量、模型、接入与硬件证据。

components.name: Pipeline Microbatch
components.summary_en: Owner-led calibrated pipeline-parallel microbatch scheduling carrier spanning scheduler, executor, communication, KV, worker, and benchmark boundaries.
components.summary_zh: 校准式流水并行 microbatch 调度的原负责人研究载体，跨越 scheduler、executor、通信、KV、worker 与评测边界。
components.public_effect_en: Research preview: calibrated pipeline-parallel microbatch scheduling across scheduler, executor, communication, KV, and worker boundaries. Public matched results are pending.
components.public_effect_zh: 研究预览：跨 scheduler、executor、通信、KV 与 worker 边界进行校准式流水并行 microbatch 调度；公开配对结果待补。

compatibility.requirements_en: Rank-local cost prediction and deterministic microbatch assignment are installable and inspectable; neutral scheduler, executor, communication, KV attachment, and matched performance evidence are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: rank-local 成本预测与确定性 microbatch 分配可安装、可检查；激活前仍需中立的 scheduler、executor、通信、KV 接入与匹配性能证据。

components.name: QoS Scheduler
components.summary_en: Owner-led deadline-aware TTFT, TBT, and TTLT scheduler-policy carrier; it is not a deployment system or control plane.
components.summary_zh: 面向 TTFT、TBT 与 TTLT deadline 的原负责人 scheduler-policy 载体；不是部署系统或控制面。
components.public_effect_en: Capability preview: schedule against TTFT, TBT, and TTLT deadlines through a runtime policy extension. Public SLO and throughput results are pending.
components.public_effect_zh: 能力预览：通过运行时策略扩展面向 TTFT、TBT 与 TTLT deadline 调度；公开 SLO 与吞吐结果待补。

compatibility.requirements_en: Request SLO validation, monotonic deadline tracking, and ordering keys are installable and inspectable; API/scheduler attachment, fairness, admission, and SLO receipts are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 请求 SLO 校验、单调 deadline 跟踪与排序键可安装、可检查；激活前仍需 API/scheduler 接入、公平性、准入与 SLO 回执。

components.name: Mapped-Host KV Offload
components.name_zh: 映射主机内存 KV 卸载
components.summary_en: Import-only Ascend contract package for mapped-host KV offload. It implements dependency-neutral layout and native-capability validation without loading torch, vLLM, or a device library.
components.summary_zh: 面向映射宿主内存 KV offload 的 Ascend import-only 合同包；已实现零依赖布局与原生能力校验，不加载 torch、vLLM 或设备库。
components.public_effect_en: CPU-validated contract: reject mismatched, strided, unaligned, non-canonical, or incomplete native-capability plans before host integration. Worker and hardware activation remain pending.
components.public_effect_zh: CPU 已验证合同：在宿主集成前拒绝不匹配、跨步、未对齐、非规范布局或原生能力不完整的方案；Worker 与硬件激活仍待完成。

compatibility.requirements_en: The mapped-memory contract and validation package is installable and inspectable but import-only; a Worker adapter, native operator, reviewed host seam, and Ascend build/test receipt are required before activation.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 映射内存合同与校验包可安装、可检查，但仅支持 import-only；激活前仍需 Worker adapter、native operator、经评审的宿主 seam 与昇腾构建/测试回执。

components.name: StateHarbor
components.summary_en: Import-only contract/reference package for request-owned KV and output state. It now contains the dependency-neutral protocol, coordinator/worker state machines, and window policy without modifying vLLM lifecycle.
components.summary_zh: 面向请求所有权 KV 与输出状态的 import-only 合同/参考实现包；已包含零依赖协议、协调端/工作端状态机和窗口策略，但不修改 vLLM 生命周期。
components.public_effect_en: CPU-validated reference behavior: deterministic ownership, epoch fencing, reserve/receipt/publication invariants, and receipt-driven decode/prefill windows. Host and device integration remain pending.
components.public_effect_zh: CPU 已验证参考行为：确定性所有权、epoch fence、reserve/receipt/publication 不变量，以及 receipt 驱动的 decode/prefill 窗口；宿主与设备集成仍待完成。

platforms: CPU reference tests only; runtime platform unverified
compatibility.requirements_en: The ownership and window-policy reference package is CPU-testable, installable, and inspectable but import-only; vLLM activation, runtime ownership, rollback, and recovery tests remain required.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 所有权与窗口策略参考包可在 CPU 测试、安装和检查，但仅支持 import-only；仍需补齐 vLLM 激活、运行时所有权、回滚与恢复测试。

components.name: Scheduler Policy Lab
components.summary_en: Owner-led comparison workspace for runtime transitions, scheduler baseline ports, and structured-output effectiveness telemetry; it is not one deployable plugin.
components.summary_zh: 面向运行时转换、scheduler baseline 移植与结构化输出有效性 telemetry 的原负责人对比工作区；不是单一可部署插件。

compatibility.requirements_en: Each deployable policy must graduate into its own typed extension.
compatibility.requirements_zh: 每个可部署策略须单独毕业为类型化扩展。

components.name: vLLM-HUST Benchmark
components.summary_en: Canonical workload, run-manifest, result-schema, and benchmark evidence repository.
components.summary_zh: 工作负载、运行清单、结果 schema 与评测证据的主仓库。

components.name: vLLM-HUST Documentation
components.summary_en: Canonical home for organization architecture, governance, decisions, and the ecosystem registry.
components.summary_zh: 组织架构、治理、决策和生态 registry 的主仓库。

components.name: vLLM-HUST Website
components.summary_en: Public renderer of canonical ecosystem metadata and benchmark evidence.
components.summary_zh: 规范生态元数据与评测证据的公开展示层。
